scene-how.png.text: Start a task in the Devin CLI. When it needs a server, a browser, or more time, type slash handoff. A cloud Devin picks it up on its own machine, with your repo and branch, the conversation, and your uncommitted changes, and finishes with a pull request.

chunks.text: Start a task in the Devin CLI.
When it needs a server,
a browser, or more time,
type slash handoff.
A cloud Devin picks it up on its
own machine, with your repo and branch,
the conversation, and your uncommitted changes,
and finishes with a pull request.
